related.title: Crypto Architecture
related.definition: When someone says Crypto Architecture, it’s often code for ‘we don’t really know what this means, but it sounds innovative.’

related.title: Seamless Blueprint
related.definition: No meeting is complete until someone suggests Seamless Blueprint as the next big move.

related.title: Mission critical
related.definition: A term used to describe tasks that are absolutely essential, usually applied to things that are actually just mildly important.

related.title: Strategic north star
related.definition: A guiding principle that sounds inspiring but is usually just a vague statement that means nothing.

related.title: AI hallucination
related.definition: AI-related corporate buzzword that sounds futuristic but usually means "we're not sure how this works yet."
